shortDescription: Stacked z-levels (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP with live see-below. Pass 35 adds DBH air-conditioning cross-level cooling (parity with VTE), a gravship build-block for all vertical links, safe single-level deletion with auto-evacuate, and levelGen hardening so a third-party FinalizeInit postfix crash (Perspective: Ores) can't shut the subsystem down. Built green, not yet user-verified.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-25)
**NEVER launch tests with the user's full modlist (isolated=false).** 900+ mods bury our diagnostics under 50+ unrelated startup/save-load errors. ALWAYS isolated=true with a minimal companionMods set (e.g. just Dubwise.DubsBadHygiene when a DBH test is needed) + build a fresh column via the dev action "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement". The user's real column SAVE was made under the full list so it can't load isolated — test on a freshly generated column instead. Non-isolated only if the user explicitly asks.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (identity x/z; -2.5 y is altitude/sort only; 0.85 per-object shrink about each thing's own center).
- Selection survives column view switches AND pawn level-changes via stairs. All levels real maps; viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap. Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- **See-below = RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through.** Shared pattern: ONE render-aware hit-test + ONE input-scope adapter. Selection (in-place) + orders (stair routing) keep bespoke semantics.
- **Designators OUT OF SCOPE (user decision pass 33).**
- Logistics doctrine: every ferry MONOTONE. Storage=vanilla+capacity clamp + delivered-level retention (pass 34). Demand=shortfall+retention via PinnedByNativeNeed; in-flight ledger. Needs-bridge, work-migration hysteresis.
- **Soft-compat HARD RULE (relearned pass 35):** foreign types (DBH/VEF/Rimefeller) must NEVER appear in a method SIGNATURE or field — locals in method bodies only, or object-typed params cast on entry — because assembly-wide attribute scans resolve signatures even for never-called methods and hard-crash when the mod is absent. Entry points gated by ABDetect / manual-only patches.

## Subsystems + kill switches (ABGuard)
Per-subsystem kill switches in `Source/Core/ABGuard.cs`. On throw, `ABGuard.Disable(switch, e, context, subject?)` logs ONCE (`[As above, So below]`), flips the switch off (prefixes fail open), posts a non-historical in-game Message. Re-armed from Mod settings or on load. `ABBlame` names the culprit Thing/Def/Pawn+mod or mines the stack for a third-party mod. Switches: ui, levelGen, rendering, movement, combat, logistics, roofSync, weather, power, pipes, climate (defined, never Disabled), threats, hostileMove, world, social, transit, areas, async.

# PASS 35 — DBH COOLING + GRAVSHIP BLOCK + SAFE LEVEL DELETE + LEVELGEN HARDENING (built green 0/0, NOT yet user-verified)
User batch (4 items):

1. **DBH air-conditioning cross-level cooling (parity with the existing VTE AC bridge).** VTE cooling already crosses via VEFPipeBridge (VTE AC is a VEF PipeSystem net). DBH cooling rides its OWN net (`PlumbingNet`, `PipeType.Air`), where each Air net's room units (`CompRoomUnit`/`CompFreezerUnit`) and the compressor (`CompAirconBaseUnit`) scale by `pipeNet.CoolingCap = Clamp01(outdoor/indoor)`, which `HygienePipeMapComp.MapComponentTick` RECOMPUTES EVERY TICK. So a 100-tick bridge can't hold it — implemented as a **manual Harmony postfix on HygienePipeMapComp.MapComponentTick** (`Source/Compat/DBHAirconPatch.cs`, applied only when DBH active) driving `DBHAirconBridge.PoolForMap(map)`. For each air-duct riser pair it pools the two levels' outdoor+indoor capacity (computed PER-MAP-LOCAL by filtering units by `parent.Map`, so DBH's own cross-map "internet" merge can't double-count) and rewrites ONLY this map's Air-net `CoolingCap` (linked map rewrites its own on its own tick — nothing clobbers it). New defs `AB_VerticalAirDuct Up/Down` (DBH-gated patch, `CompProperties_Pipe mode=Air`, research MultiSplitAirCon, Temperature category) + `bridgeAircon` flag on `ABStairsExtension`. Gated by `crossLevelPipes` + ABGuard.Pipes. Net effect: a compressor on one level cools rooms on the linked level and works harder to match, exactly like VTE.
2. **Gravship build-block for ALL vertical links.** `Source/Levels/ABGravship.cs`: `OnSubstructure(...)` = any footprint cell has `terrainGrid.FoundationAt(c)?.IsSubstructure` (Odyssey-gated; inert without the DLC). Wired into `PlaceWorker_ABStairs.AllowsPlacing` (covers stairs, grand/wide stairs, ladders, elevator, all utility risers — they share the PlaceWorker) with reject message `AB_NoLevelsGravship`, plus a belt-and-suspenders guard in `Building_ABStairs.EstablishLink`. Rationale: level maps are separate pocket maps that can't fly with the ship.
3. **Safe single-level deletion (auto-evacuate + in-dialog opt-out).** `Building_ABStairs` gizmo "Remove level above/below" (custom icon `Textures/UI/AB_RemoveLevel.png`, falls back to deconstruct icon; shown per non-ground counterpart, player faction) opens `Dialog_ABDeleteLevel` (occupant counts + a checkbox "Evacuate ... first" defaulting ON; red loss warning when off). Confirm runs `ABLevelDeletion.DeleteLevel(level, evacuate)`: never the ground (level 0); jumps view to ground first; if evacuating, relocates player pawns + slaves + player animals/mechs + prisoners + guests (`ShouldEvacuate`) to safe cells near a ground stair landing; then `PocketMapUtility.DestroyPocketMap` (fires LevelComp.MapRemoved -> severs links, cleanup). Unhauled items + buildings on the level are lost (dialog says so). Kill switch: world. Orphaned ground-side stairs are left as unlinked (player deconstructs; rebuilding regenerates the level).
4. **BUG FIX (pastebin report) — third-party FinalizeInit postfix no longer shuts down levelGen.** Report: `Perspective: Ores` (Owlchemist.PerspectiveOres) ore-lump flood fill walks off the map edge (IndexOutOfRangeException in EdificeGrid) on our solid-rock basements, thrown from its `Map.FinalizeInit` postfix INSIDE our `MapGenerator.GenerateMap` — LevelMapGen caught it -> tripped levelGen -> the stair logged "could not resolve a target level map." Two-layer fix:
   - **General (main):** `Patch_Map_FinalizeInit_LevelGuard` — a Harmony *finalizer* on `Map.FinalizeInit` active ONLY during our generation (`LevelMapGen.CurrentContext != null`) and ONLY for faults `ABBlame.BlameMod` attributes to a THIRD-PARTY mod: swallows the exception + logs one warning naming the culprit, so a cosmetic foreign post-processor can't abort our (already-finalized) level or trip levelGen. Our own/vanilla faults propagate unchanged (still trip + discard). No effect on normal map loads (CurrentContext null).
   - **Targeted:** `PerspectiveOresCompat` — manual reflection prefix on `PerspectiveOres.PerspectiveOresSetup.ProcessMap` skipping our pocket levels (level != 0); prevents the throw + warning spam at source. Inert when PO absent (it is NOT currently subscribed on this machine, so only the finalizer is user-verifiable in isolated testing). Fails open to the generic guard.

# PASS 34 — HARDENING WAVE (built green, user-verification pending)
1. BUG1 storage-full haul loop killed (condition-based monotone delivered-level retention in CrossLevelDemand). 2. BUG2 GiddyUp raider dismount-spam fixed (AI scans call silent IsMounted; BlockForMount message only on player stair jobs, throttled). 3. BUG3 mech-recharge hardened (per-charger try/catch + WarningOnce, subject-tagged Disable). 4. BUG4 Allow Tool urgent hauling re-parented to HaulingUrgent work type. 5. QOL1 ABBlame culprit naming wired into Disable + settings row + Messages.

# PASS 33 — SEE-BELOW INPUT PARITY (USER-VERIFIED)
RMB building hit-test, elevation-lock hardening, cross-level drag-box select, targeter widening, hover mouseover readout. Follow-up (pending verify): selection preserved across stairs/elevator/ladder.

## Modern Dev Tools integration — SHIPPED About/known-issues.json
Ships `About/known-issues.json` (community-DB schema, 18 issues: 1 umbrella + 17 per-subsystem) so Modern Dev Tools explains our ABGuard subsystem shutdowns to players in-game. No dependency, inert without MDT.

## REMOVED FEATURES
SKYLIGHTS (round 7). MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12). Stairwell heat exchange (2026-07-21 user directive) — pocket-map ambient temp (ClimatePatches) unaffected; cross-level TEMPERATURE now flows only through DBH aircon (pass 35) and VTE/VEF pipe bridges.

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · Batch A · mech charge crash gone · bill supply + mech RMB · PASS 33 see-below input parity.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 (VERIFIED) · basement (VERIFIED) · haul/ferry (p32 monotone + p34 retention) · below lighting · animal flows · mech charge (VERIFIED + p34 hardened) · work-migration commitment · elevation lock (VERIFIED) · drag-box select (VERIFIED) · targeter widening (VERIFIED) · hover readout (VERIFIED) · selection-across-stairs (p33, pending) · GiddyUp no-spam / Allow Tool Haul+ / culprit naming (p34, pending) · **DBH aircon cross-level cooling (p35, pending)** · **gravship build-block (p35, pending)** · **safe level deletion w/ auto-evacuate (p35, pending)** · **levelGen FinalizeInit-postfix hardening + Perspective:Ores compat (p35, pending)** · MDT known-issues.json · P0-P3 parity. REMOVED: skylights, mountain rivers, stairwell heat exchange. OUT OF SCOPE: cross-level designators.

## Compat
DBH (water + **p35 air-conditioning cooling**)/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE · Biomes! Caverns · Alpha Biomes · BM+MO · Odyssey+VLE (**p35 gravship build-block**) · Misc. Robots/++ · Hauler's Dream+PUAH · Allow Tool (p34 Haul+) · Ancient urban ruins · CE · Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up (p34)/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF · Trader Airships, Hospitality · BAM · PO/Dubs Analyzer/TPT · WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage · Modern Dev Tools · **Perspective: Ores (p35: skip our pocket levels; generic FinalizeInit guard also covers any foreign post-processor)** · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE (run ISOLATED + dev-built column)
**PASS 35 (TOP):**
- DBH cooling (companion Dubwise.DubsBadHygiene): build a column, run vertical air ducts up/down through the shaft, put an outdoor+indoor unit on one level and only an indoor unit (roomed) on the other -> the remote room cools; compressor's ConnectedCoolingCapacity reflects the pooled demand.
- Gravship (needs Odyssey + a built gravship/substructure): try to place any vertical link on substructure -> refused with AB_NoLevelsGravship; normal ground still builds.
- Safe delete: build sky + basement, put a colonist/animal on a level, select a ground-side stair, "Remove level above/below" -> confirm with evacuate ON (pawns land on surface, level gone, colony intact) AND once with evacuate OFF (red warning, level+contents gone). Ground level offers no such gizmo.
- LevelGen hardening: can't reproduce the exact Perspective:Ores crash in isolation (PO not subscribed; full list not used) — verify no regression: fresh column still generates cleanly, no levelGen trip.
Pass-34 queue still pending (BUG1-4/QOL1 companions), pass-33 selection-across-stairway, pass-32 ferry round-2, compat session, perf/CE-absent/translation/soak/publishing, P4 sweep.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky+basement · basement diagnostic · light diagnostic · RMB diagnostic · below-view diagnostic.

## Status
2026-07-25 (35th pass): DBH air-con cross-level cooling, gravship build-block, safe single-level deletion (auto-evacuate + opt-out), and levelGen FinalizeInit-postfix hardening + Perspective:Ores compat — built green (0 warn/0 err), NOT yet user-verified. Testing per directive is ISOLATED + dev-built column; DBH cooling needs the DubsBadHygiene companion.
